title: The Bright Colony
author: Rafael Eriksen
blurb: Ulyana Winterbourne, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
